$comment: editorconfig-checker config. It covers the file types dotnet format never sees:
IndentSize is disabled deliberately, not because it is noisy. The check counts leading
spaces and requires a multiple of indent_size, which is wrong for aligned continuation
lines that are idiomatic in every language here: a C# expression continued under an
operator, an XML comment whose second line aligns under the first, and a markdown list
item continued at 3 spaces to align under '1. '. dotnet format already owns C# indentation
